title: ManifestEpr
description: EPR envelope wrapping a manifest payload. The Manifest entry type in the elohim DNA's content_store_integrity zome stores instances; the projector controller mirrors them into the local manifests table for fast operational lookup. The integrity zome validates floor-protection invariants (kind whitelist, valid JSON, revision >= 1, pillar required for pillar-projection); this schema is the wire-format contract for clients composing or inspecting Manifest EPRs.

kind.description: Constitutional EPR kind. Manifests are floor-protected — circulate at Standing::Unknown and below the gradient threshold.

reach.description: Reach level for this manifest. Pillar-projection and app manifests typically use Reach::Public or above; private manifests are local-only floor-protected.

signerPubkey.description: Base64-encoded ed25519 public key of the signer (steward authoring this manifest).

signature.description: Base64-encoded ed25519 signature over canonical_bytes(envelope || payload).

schemaRef.description: Optional CID of an EPR pointing to a more specific schema for this manifest. Resolved by the schemaRef walker (Phase 3 T9), depth-bounded by Standing for non-load-bearing kinds; protocol-load-bearing schemaRefs (Manifest itself) walk unbounded.

manifestKind.description: Bootstrap taxonomy of manifest kinds. Must match the integrity zome's Manifest::validate() whitelist (T7).

pillar.description: Pillar name (e.g. 'lamad', 'shefa', 'qahal'). Required when manifestKind is pillar-projection — the projection rules bind EPR kinds to a pillar's read-model tables.

revision.description: Monotonic revision number. Insert-or-bump in the projection (T4) — higher revision wins on idempotent replay.

kinds.description: EPR kinds this manifest claims projection authority over. Required when manifestKind is pillar-projection.

writeThrough.description: Optional write-through declaration (Phase 2B Batch C). Read by ManifestRegistry into WriteThroughState (T11) for signal-emit gating.

floor.description: Constitutional standing-immune floor declaration. Required when manifestKind is standing-policy. T7 bundles standing-policy-floor.schema.json via include_str! and validates this sub-object at integrity-zome create-time. All five standing-immune classes (§2.8) must be present.

Constitutional tending-immune floor declaration. Required when manifestKind is tending-policy. T7 bundles tending-policy-floor.schema.json via include_str! and validates this sub-object at integrity-zome create-time. All five tending-immune classes (§2.8) must be present.
